scientific_integrity: Analytic infinite-parameter proof with exact-rational finite checks; no claims of independent verification or exhaustive bibliography.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for integral shape r>=3 and reciprocal-integer failure parameter 1/(t+1), t>=1. The exact crossing index is not evaluated. Possible bibliographic equivalent coverage, especially in inaccessible Perrin-Redside full text, is a residual risk.
title: Strong left-loadedness for every negative-binomial shape at least three
